findings.diagnosis: Infers an unqualified guarantee of secret safety from end-to-end encryption of synchronization.
findings.evidence: Lines 25–27 and 44–46 describe encryption of history sync. Lines 51 and 56 describe local history storage and retention of the old history file; the page establishes no corresponding protection for those copies. Sync encryption alone does not establish the broader safety assurance.
findings.deletion_test: Deleting the quoted clause removes the unsupported safety guarantee while preserving the encryption claim and all setup instructions.
